def dist(a,b):
    return min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in a for r2,c2 in b)
def analyze(name, gi, go):
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg)
    diff=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    ch={(r,c) for r,c,*_ in diff}; tgt=diff[0][3]
    donor=[x for x in ci if ch & set(x[2])][0]
    cnt=Counter(x[0] for x in ci)
    uniq=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==1]
    print('==',name,'target',tgt,'unique colors',uniq)
    for u in uniq:
        us=[x for x in ci if x[0]==u][0]
        print(' unique shape size',us[1],'cells sample',sorted(us[2])[:2])
    n=len(ci); parent=list(range(n))
    def find(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: x=parent[x]
        return x
    pairs=[]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if variants(ci[i][2]) & variants(ci[j][2]):
                pairs.append((i,j)); parent[find(i)]=find(j)
    from collections import defaultdict
    gd=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n): gd[find(i)].append(i)
    dcells=[x[2] for x in ci]
    for k,v in gd.items():
        if len(v)<2: continue
        mx=max(ci[i][1] for i in v)
        print(' group maxsize',mx)
        for i in v:
            x=ci[i]
            dd=[dist(x[2],us[2]) for us in ci if us[0] in uniq and x[0] not in uniq]
            dmin=min(dd) if dd else None
            pd=min(dist(x[2],dcells[j]) for j in v if j!=i)
            print('   color',x[0],'size',x[1],'top',min(r for r,c in x[2]),'dist_to_unique',dmin,'dist_to_partner',pd,'DONOR' if x is donor else '')
analyze('d1',demo_in,demo_out)
analyze('d2',demo2_in,demo2_out)
analyze('d3',demo3_in,demo3_out)

import math
def feats(name, gi, go):
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg)
    diff=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    ch={(r,c) for r,c,*_ in diff}
    donor=[x for x in ci if ch & set(x[2])][0]
    n=len(ci); parent=list(range(n))
    def find(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: x=parent[x]
        return x
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if variants(ci[i][2]) & variants(ci[j][2]): parent[find(i)]=find(j)
    from collections import defaultdict
    gd=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n): gd[find(i)].append(i)
    # largest group by size*members
    best=max([v for v in gd.values() if len(v)>1], key=lambda v:(max(ci[i][1] for i in v)*len(v), max(ci[i][1] for i in v)))
    cnt=Counter(x[0] for x in ci)
    R,C=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    print('==',name)
    for i in best:
        x=ci[i]; cells=x[2]
        ctr=(sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells), sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells))
        uniqs=[y for y in ci if cnt[y[0]]==1 and y[0]!=x[0]]
        du=min(math.dist(ctr,(sum(r for r,c in y[2])/len(y[2]), sum(c for r,c in y[2])/len(y[2]))) for y in uniqs) if uniqs else None
        same=[y[2] for y in ci if y[0]==x[0] and y is not x]
        ds=min(min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in cells for r2,c2 in y) for y in same) if same else None
        edge=min(min(r for r,c in cells), min(R-1-r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells), min(C-1-c for r,c in cells))
        others=[y[2] for y in ci if y is not x]
        do=min(min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in cells for r2,c2 in y) for y in others)
        print('  col',x[0],'size',x[1],'top',min(r for r,c in cells),'d_uniq_centroid',round(du,1) if du else '-',
              'd_samecolor',ds,'edge_gap',edge,'d_anyshape',do,'globalcnt',cnt[x[0]],'DONOR' if x is donor else '')
for nm,gi,go in [('d1',demo_in,demo_out),('d2',demo2_in,demo2_out),('d3',demo3_in,demo3_out),('d4',d4_in,d4_out)]:
    feats(nm,gi,go)

def feats2(name, gi, go):
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg)
    diff=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    ch=set(diff)
    donor=[x for x in ci if ch & set(x[2])][0]
    n=len(ci); parent=list(range(n))
    def find(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: x=parent[x]
        return x
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if variants(ci[i][2]) & variants(ci[j][2]): parent[find(i)]=find(j)
    from collections import defaultdict
    gd=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n): gd[find(i)].append(i)
    best=max([v for v in gd.values() if len(v)>1], key=lambda v:(max(ci[i][1] for i in v)*len(v), max(ci[i][1] for i in v)))
    cnt=Counter(x[0] for x in ci); cellcnt=Counter()
    for x in ci: cellcnt[x[0]]+=len(x[2])
    # target singleton: unique color whose shape not in best group... use color of diff destination
    tcol=go[diff[0][0]][diff[0][1]]
    tgt=[x for x in ci if x[0]==tcol][0]
    R=len(gi)
    mem=sorted(best, key=lambda i:(min(r for r,c in ci[i][2]), min(c for r,c in ci[i][2])))
    print('==',name,'target',tcol)
    order=0
    for i in mem:
        x=ci[i]
        order+=1
        d=min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in x[2] for r2,c2 in tgt[2])
        print(f'  #{order} col{x[0]} top{min(r for r,c in x[2])} d_minmanh {d} globalshapes {cnt[x[0]]} globalcells {cellcnt[x[0]]}', 'DONOR' if x is donor else '')
for nm,gi,go in [('d1',demo_in,demo_out),('d2',demo2_in,demo2_out),('d3',demo3_in,demo3_out),('d4',d4_in,d4_out)]:
    feats2(nm,gi,go)

def feats3(name, gi, go):
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg)
    diff=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    ch=set(diff)
    donor=[x for x in ci if ch & set(x[2])][0]
    n=len(ci); parent=list(range(n))
    def find(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: x=parent[x]
        return x
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            if variants(ci[i][2]) & variants(ci[j][2]): parent[find(i)]=find(j)
    from collections import defaultdict
    gd=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(n): gd[find(i)].append(i)
    best=max([v for v in gd.values() if len(v)>1], key=lambda v:(max(ci[i][1] for i in v)*len(v), max(ci[i][1] for i in v)))
    cnt=Counter(x[0] for x in ci)
    tcol=go[diff[0][0]][diff[0][1]]
    others=[x for x in ci if cnt[x[0]]==1 and x[0]!=tcol and x not in [ci[i] for i in best]]
    print('==',name,'other singletons:',[(x[0],len(x[2]),min(r for r,c in x[2]),min(c for r,c in x[2])) for x in others])
    for i in best:
        x=ci[i]
        ds=[min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in x[2] for r2,c2 in o[2]) for o in others]
        print(f'  col{x[0]} top{min(r for r,c in x[2])} d_other_singletons {ds}', 'DONOR' if x is donor else '')
for nm,gi,go in [('d2',demo2_in,demo2_out),('d3',demo3_in,demo3_out),('d4',d4_in,d4_out)]:
    feats3(nm,gi,go)

def feats_all(gi,go):
    cl,bg=comps4(gi)
    diff={(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    dcells=[frozenset(x[2]) for x in cl if diff & x[2]]
    tcol=go[list(diff)[0][0]][list(diff)[0][1]]
    tgt=[x[2] for x in cl if x[0]==tcol and not (diff & x[2])][0]
    bysig=defaultdict(list)
    for x in cl: bysig[sig(x[2])[0]].append(x)
    rows=[]; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    for x in cl:
        cells=x[2]; s,h,w=sig(cells)
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        edges=sum(1 for r,c in cells if r==0 or r==H-1 or c==0 or c==W-1)
        rows.append(dict(col=x[0],sz=x[1],top=r0,left=c0,ntwin=len(bysig[s]),
            d=dist(cells,tgt), donor=(frozenset(cells) in dcells), edges=edges))
    return bg,tcol,rows
for nm,gi,go in demos:
    bg,tcol,rows=feats_all(gi,go)
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
    print('==',nm,'bg',bg,'tcol',tcol)
    print(df.sort_values(['ntwin','d'],ascending=[False,True]).to_string(index=False))
